title: Welsh & Shedar Anime Launches Webtoon
content:
French entertainment company Ankama announced on Wednesday that a 12-episode webtoon adaptation of the original television anime Aoki Denshō Welsh & Shedar (The Azure Legend: Welsh & Shedar ) launched on Ankama 's own French comic platform Allskreen and the Ankama Launcher portal app on the same day. The project brings together multiple artists for each episode. New episodes debut each week.

Ankama assistant screenwriter Lily Roux is the writer, Krosmoz artist Mig is the artist and Sébastien Lamirand is the colorist for the first episode. Other artists will also contribute to the project inclduding Faorynn, Cha, Boky, Nasak_art, GoMar, and Quentiron.

The anime's story centers on a country boy named Welsh, and a prince destined to become a king named Shedar. The two boys are from different stations in life, but their destinies intertwine when they try to end a tyrant's plot to conquer the world.

The anime premiered on October 2 on Tokyo MX at 9:25 p.m. JST (8:25 a.m. EDT).

Ankama is an independent entertainment and digital creation group most widely known for the DOFUS tactical MMORPG, which launched in 2004. The company also published Atsushi Kaneko 's SOIL manga , and Suguro Chayamachi 's Togainu no Chi manga in French.

title: Godzilla Minus Zero Film Opens at #1 in Japan, Grotesqqque Anime Film at #8
content:
Godzilla Minus Zero , the new Godzilla sequel film from Godzilla Minus One 's Takashi Yamazaki , ranked at #1 in its first weekend. The film sold 699,000 tickets and earned 1,130,171,300 yen (about US$7.11 million) over the November 6-8 weekend.

However, the film actually had an irregular opening day in Japan, opening on Tuesday, November 3 (films in Japan usually open on Fridays), which is "Godzilla Day" in Japan, celebrating the anniversary of the first Godzilla film's November 3, 1954 release. The film earned 590,000 tickets for 910 million yen (about US$5.75 million) in Japan in its opening day alone, setting a new record for the highest opening day earnings for a live-action film (among both foreign and domestic live-action films) in Japan. The film had 201% higher opening day earnings than its predecessor Godzilla Minus One in Japan. The film sold 1.61 million tickets and earned 2,539,531,100 yen (about US$15.98 million) in its first six days.

Godzilla Minus One similarly opened in Japan on November 3, 2023. (Godzilla Day fell on a Tuesday this year, but it is also the Japanese holiday known as Culture Day.)

The sequel is set in 1949, two years after the Godzilla Minus One film's story.

Min Tanaka ( 47 Ronin , live-action Rurouni Kenshin films) plays biologist Kanji Murakami. He joined returning cast members Ryūnosuke Kamiki (Koichi Shikishima), Minami Hamabe (Noriko Ōishi), and Hidetaka Yoshioka (Noda) from Godzilla Minus One . Also returning in the cast are Yūki Yamada (Shiro Mizushima), Kuranosuke Sasaki (Seiji Akitsu), Sakura Andō (Sumiko Ota), and Miō Tanaka (Tatsuo Ho tta).

Yamazaki returned as director, screenwriter, and VFX supervisor. Naoki Satō also returned to compose the music. Shirogumi Inc. handled the film's visual effects.

The live-action film adaptation of Yuu Nagira 's Nanji, Hoshi no Gotoku (You Are Akin to the Stars) novel dropped from #2 to #3 in its fifth weekend. The film sold 72,000 tickets and earned 107,330,000 yen (about US$675,700) from Friday to Sunday. The film has sold a total of 1.32 million tickets and earned a cumulative total of 1,937,022,200 yen (about US$12.19 million).

The film opened in Japan on October 9, and ranked at #4 in its opening weekend. The film sold 234,000 tickets and earned 350,531,400 yen (about US$2.23 million) in its first three days.

The film stars Ryūsei Yokohama ( Detective Conan: Highway no Datenshi 's Kazuaki Ōmae) as Kai Aono and Suzu Hirose (live-action Chihayafuru films' Chihaya, The Boy and The Beast 's Kaede) as Akimi Inoue. Michihito Fujii (live-action Last Samurai Standing ) directed the film off a screenplay by Naoko Adachi (live-action Daytime Shooting Star , Un chocolatier de l'amour perdu ).

The novel's story begins on an island in the Seto Inland Sea. Akimi, who lives on the island, meets Kai, who just moved to the island. Both bond over their misgivings about their own families and life. Akimi's home life is strained by her father constantly cheating, while Kai's mother constantly makes both of them move to be with a new relationship. The two get into a complicated, supporting, and co-dependent relationship over the course of 15 years.

The Kamen Rider Kabuto Tuentīsu Ten o Tsugu Mono film ranked at #4 in its opening weekend. The film earned 88,085,058 yen (about US$554,500) in its first three days. The film opened in Japan on November 6.

Eiga Chiikawa: Ningyo no Shima no Himitsu ( Chiikawa the Movie: The Secret of Mermaid Island), the first anime film adaptation of Nagano 's Chiikawa manga, stayed at #5 in its 16th weekend in Japan's box office. The film earned 55,518,700 yen (about US$349,500) from Friday to Sunday.

The film has sold a total of 12.86 million tickets, and earned a cumulative total of 18,793,145,700 yen (about US$118 million). The film is currently the biggest film in Japan this year, and now ranks 12th in Japan's all-time box office ranking.

Eiga Chiikawa: Ningyo no Shima no Himitsu opened on July 24 and ranked at #1 for its opening weekend. The film earned 990 million yen (about US$6.05 million) on its opening day. The film sold 1,508,500 tickets and earned 2,240,333,500 yen (about US$13.70 million) in its first three days.

The film's 4DX screenings began on September 5. One-day-only cheering screenings for the film took place on September 11. Penlight screenings took place on September 23.

The film is based on the manga's arc posted on X (formerly Twitter ) from March to November 2023, nicknamed the "Siren Arc" or "Island Arc."

Nagano is credited for the original story and also wrote the film's script. Under Nagano 's supervision, Kei Oikawa ( Uma Musume Pretty Derby 3 seasons, Hinamatsuri , My Teen Romantic Comedy SNAFU TOO! , My Teen Romantic Comedy SNAFU Climax ) directed the film at Cygames Pictures . QTORY inc. managed the production, and TOHO is distributing the film.

The live-action film reboot of CAPCOM 's Resident Evil survival horror game franchise dropped from #3 to #7 in its fifth weekend. The film earned 60,618,750 yen (about US$381,600) from Friday to Sunday, and has earned a cumulative total of 2,153,054,600 yen (about US$13.55 million).

The film opened in Japan on October 9 and ranked at #2 in its opening weekend. The film sold 356,000 tickets and earned 626,567,150 yen (about US$3.97 million) in its first three days.

The film opened in the United States on September 18. The film ranked at #1 and earned an estimated US$60 million in its opening weekend in the U.S.

The film stars Austin Abrams ( Weapons , Euphoria , Wolfs ) as Bryan. The cast also includes Zach Cherry , Kali Reis , and Paul Walter Hauser ( Richard Jewell , Black Bird , The Fantastic Four: First Steps ).

Zach Cregger ( Barbarian , Weapons ) directed the new film.

Atsushi Nishigori 's original anime film Grotesqqque (previously titled Grotesque) opened at #8. The film earned 47,185,800 yen (about US$297,000) in its first three days.

The film is an omnibus film of three stories with different worldviews.

• "A(E)liens"

• "Yoroshiku★Girl," (also known as "4649 Girl," pronounced as "Yoroshiku★Shōjo," a pun on the words "Nice to Meet You★Girl" with the literal meaning of the kanji being "Evening Dew Heads to Its Death★Girl." The numbers 4649 can be read in Japanese as "Yoroshiku.")

• "Nocturne: Nuit Grotesque" ("Nocturne: Kono Grotesque na Yoru ni," literally, Nocturne: On This Grotesque Night, romanized in a previous video as "Nocturn: En Cette Nuit Grotesque.")

Atsushi Nishigori ( The IDOLM@STER , DARLING in the FRANXX ) directed the film, and also wrote the screenplay and designed the characters.

The band METALVERSE performs the opening theme song "Shoot Shoot Shoot." Haoto performs the ending theme song with lyrics by momosu momosu.

The film comes from JOEN , the company jointly established by Sony media subsidiary Aniplex , its CloverWorks animation studio, Production I.G sister company Wit Studio , and publisher Shueisha . CloverWorks producer Yūichi Fukushima and Wit Studio producer Tetsuya Nakatake are the representative directors of JOEN .

The film opened in Japan on November 6. The film had its world premiere at this year's Fantasia International Film Festival , which took place in Montreal from July 16-August 2.

The live-action film of Mika Yamamori 's In the Clear Moonlit Dusk ( Uruwashi no Yoi no Tsuki ) manga left the top 10 in its third weekend.

Made in Abyss: Mezameru Shinpi ( Made in Abyss : Awakening Mystery), the first film in the new Made in Abyss anime film series , dropped off the list in its third weekend.

The 4K restoration of Studio Ghibli 's Whisper of the Heart is off the top 10 in its third week and final week, but still earned 42,232,800 yen (about US$265,800) from Friday to Sunday. The 4K restoration screenings have earned a cumulative total of 410,503,800 yen (about US$2.58 million). It ranked at #10 in its first weekend. The film earned 112,466,900 yen (about US$713,200) in its first three days.

Nijiiro no Rinne (Rainbow-Colored Reincarnation), the seventh film in Yamato yo Towa ni: Rebel 3199 ( Star Blazers: Be Forever Yamato - Rebel 3199 ), the latest project in the Space Battleship Yamato remakes, left the list in its second weekend.

title: Crunchyroll Screens The Guy She Was Interested In Wasn't a Guy at All, Here U Are, Bless Premieres at Anime Frontier
content:
Crunchyroll announced on Wednesday that it will stream the premieres of the anime adaptation of Sumiko Arai 's The Guy She Was Interested In Wasn't a Guy at All ( Ki ni Natteru Hito ga Otoko Janakatta ) manga, the anime adaptation of D JUN 's Here U Are webtoon, the television anime of Yukino Sonoyama 's Bless manga, and the television anime of Kyousuke Motomi 's Dengeki Daisy shōjo manga from Aniplex at this year's Anime Frontier event on December 6 from 1:45 p.m.-3:45 p.m.

Crunchyroll also confirmed that it will screen the following premieres at the event on December 6 at 11:00 a.m.-12:00 p.m.:

• Fate Rewinder

• Medaka Kuroiwa is Impervious to My Charms Season 2, Episode 1

• Shangri-La Frontier Season 3, Episode 1

Anime Frontier 2026 will run in Fort Worth, Texas from December 4-6.

The company will reveal more premiere titles for its screenings on December 4 at 3:30 p.m.-5:00 p.m. in the future. The screenings on that day already include the first three episodes of the new Magic Knight Rayearth anime at 5:45 p.m-7:05 p.m.

title: 3 Gutsiest Characters In One Piece
content:
The pirate’s life is paved with blood and near-death experiences, especially when it comes to the characters in One Piece . It takes some unhinged individuals to face super powered Warlords, Marine Admirals and ruthless pirates, yet Monkey D. Luffy and friends almost embrace the agony . The whole crew faces death throughout the series and usually escapes alive, albeit with some large scars.

A few along the way haven’t been as fortunate as the Straw Hats . Bravery comes at a cost and this series features numerous tough defeats that cost more than the fight was worth. Nevertheless, Luffy and his crew won’t back down, even it does lead them into some truly gratuitous situations. His band of maniacs would follow their captain into the most dire of circumstances, and these are three of the gutsiest that reflect that.

3) Monkey D. Luffy

I’m not sure if it’s guts or foolishness at times, but the Straw-Hat captain isn’t afraid of a fight to the death. But would anyone expect anything less from a pirate that can’t swim due to eating a cursed fruit? Luffy risks death every time he boards a ship. But in all seriousness, the rubber man knows how to take a beating and still claw his way to a win. He’s far from the strongest physical character in the show, but continues to learn and get better.

In the Alabasta Arc, he’s defeated twice by Crocodile but resiliently wins the decisive third fight to free the kingdom. Those losses came with some deep pain, including a hook being slashed through him and his limbs being dehydrated to almost nothing. Magellan’s poison nearly killed him, and was so devastating that he had to receive a treatment that took 10 years off his life. The dude’s toughness can’t be questioned.

The most memorable moment of pain for Luffy came at Marineford. The emotional toll will be touched on in the next list entry, but Marine Admiral Akainu’s magma powers left a giant burnt “X” scar on Luffy’s chest. It remains there to this day and embodies just some of the pain and suffering he and his crew have been through to rise to pirate greatness.

2) Portgas D. Ace

Sorry to give everyone a brief moment of PTSD, but it’s tough to match Ace’s guts in his final act. Older brother knew when he jumped in front of Akainu’s punch that he wouldn’t survive, but he defended Luffy until his final breath. Ace rarely ran into a worthy opponent, but Akainu’s magma powers overwhelmed Ace’s fire abilities swiftly. The insanely high power of Akainu didn’t stop Ace from courageously throwing himself into the path of the punch.

He took it and accepted his fate. Akainu punched a hole clean through him, melting Ace’s insides. It doesn’t get any gutsier than that. Although his opportunities throughout the show were brief to display his toughness, Ace just needed one chance. He then proceeds to find a way to thank Luffy and his friends for loving him, despite having almost no ability to breathe. It’s a tragic, but beautiful final scene for the fire fist warrior.

1) Roronoa Zoro

Death might’ve been preferable to most people than what Roronoa Zoro has faced throughout the years. Even in his introductory episode, he’s on death’s doorstep. Marine Captain Morgan starved the former bounty hunter and had him tied up out in the hot sun. The plan was to execute him by firing squad, so the care for Zoro was basically non-existent while he was out in the elements.

Dracule Mihawk then slit his chest completely open just a few episodes later when the two encountered each other on the Baratie. The wound would’ve killed a lesser man. The grand finale of this man’s pain is undoubtedly him taking on all of Luffy’s pain in the Thriller Bark Arc. Bartholomew Kuma lets Zoro know that doing this could prove fatal .

However, the swordsman doesn’t hesitate. Zoro survives another brush with death, and his guts can’t be questioned. Still, is that really the positive outcome for him? Living to fight another day just means another painful arc ahead for Luffy’s first mate. Zoro doesn’t care. It’s just on to the next fight and that’s what makes him the gutsiest character in the anime. Who do you think is deserving of this title in One Piece ? Let us know in the comments.

Living to fight another day just means another painful arc ahead for Luffy’s first mate. Zoro doesn’t care. It’s just on to the next fight and that’s what makes him the gutsiest character in the anime. Who do you think is deserving of this title in One Piece ? Let us know in the comments.

title: Gundam Seed Freedom Zero Prequel Anime Film Gets Novel
content:
Goto penned the novelizations for Mobile Suit Gundam Seed and Mobile Suit Gundam Seed Destiny and also penned the script for the Mobile Suit Gundam Seed FREEDOM film. Tomofumi Ogasawara , who drew illustrations for the Mobile Suit Gundam Seed novelization, is drawing the illustrations for the novels. The Mobile Suit Gundam Seed FREEDOM novel ended with its second volume, which shipped in March 2024.

The Mobile Suit Gundam Seed FREEDOM ZERO film will open in theaters in Japan on January 15 and in North America in February 2027.

A teaser video had announced the prequel when it debuted during the second round of special edition screenings for Gundam Seed FREEDOM in Japanese theaters in November 2024.

Director Mitsuo Fukuda , producer Hisakazu Naka , and Sōichirō Hoshi , voice of Kira Yamato, appeared at a stage greeting during the first screening announcing the prequel. They revealed that screenwriter Chiaki Morosawa and Shigeru Morita wrote the prequel's scenario while planning for Gundam Seed Freedom itself. In addition, Fukuda stated that the script for Gundam Seed FREEDOM ZERO was completed 20 years ago.

Gundam Seed FREEDOM ZERO's storyboards were nearly half finished, and the oldest storyboards actually predate those of Gundam Seed Freedom itself. The dialogue recording has also already been completed. Fukuda added that 20 years ago, Gundam Seed FREEDOM ZERO was originally planned as an original video anime ( OVA ), but the staff has not yet decided how it will be presented now.

Mobile Suit Gundam Seed FREEDOM opened in Japan in January 2024. The film debuted at #1 in the Japanese box office. It sold 634,182 tickets for 1,065,983,130 yen (about US$7.20 million) in its first three days, marking the Gundam franchise 's highest three-day opening in box office earnings. The film is the highest-earning Gundam film in Japan ever.

Bandai Namco Filmworks and Fathom Events screened the film in the United States and Canada in May 2024. Netflix is streaming the film .

title: Forgotten 2000s Classic Gets New U.S. Release With No Hopes for Season 2
content:
One of the most beloved Shonen hits from the 2000s returned with a Blu-ray release this year, while there has been no hope for Season 2. With the massive expansion of the anime industry over the past few years, catering to a global audience. As such, many shows often get overlooked by the audience or animation studios even if they have exceptional storytelling. One of the most frustrating feelings while watching a really compelling anime is that it ends on a cliffhanger, only for the studio to never release another season. These shows actually get a huge fan base initially, but everyone eventually forgets as the years pass.

Toradora! is one such series that never returned with a second season even though the anime debuted in 2008. However, while there’s no hope for a sequel season, Discotek Media released a Blu-ray DVD of the series. The Blu-ray release was announced in August this year before it was officially released on the official website. Discotek confirmed that all 25 episodes of the anime and the OVA are included with an improved version of the English subtitles. The set also includes a few bonuses, including creditless opening and ending themes, DVD and music promos, Ami’s 150 Impersonation Medley Bonus Clip, and more.

Toradora! Makes a Much-Needed Return After Crunchyroll Removal

Now that the anime isn’t available on Crunchyroll, this new release will be crucial for many fans. In April last year, the platform quietly removed this anime due to licensing issues and hasn’t confirmed its return since. It’s not rare for the platform to quietly remove some beloved shows without any announcement. Even though several anime are exclusive to the platform, Crunchyroll only buys rights to stream them for a certain period of time. Over time, the license expires, forcing the platform to remove such anime from its library.

Additionally, while Crunchyroll can renew those licenses, it depends on the popularity of the anime. Regardless of critical acclaim, if an anime doesn’t have a good enough viewership, the platform would prefer to let it go and cut costs. While Toradora! used to be one of the biggest hits of the 2000s, the hype has significantly died down over the years. Especially since the anime hasn’t returned with a second season, it may never get back in the spotlight without a reboot. While the anime isn’t available to stream on Crunchyrol l, fans can still watch the subbed version on Prime Video.

Toradora! Is One of the Best Romance Comedies of All Time

While the anime hasn’t returned with a sequel, the manga is still ongoing. The series stands out for its portrayal of complex and flawed characters, all the while blending comedic relief in the most unexpected moments. The story follows a kind boy with a face that often gets him in trouble and a fiery girl who stands out for her hot temper and small stature. Although they couldn’t be more different from each other, they start out as reluctant allies trying to help each other confess to each of their best friends. However, the story continues as their relationship grows from allies into something much more. It doesn’t happen quickly since it’s a slow-burn romance, which is all the more why fans find it intriguing, as the romantic tension and the nuanced emotional writing continue for much longer than expected.

title: Final Fantasy XIV Game Band The Primals' Bassist Eikichi Iwai Dies
content:
Iwai had just performed a concert with the band during the game's Fan Festival event in Tokyo on November 1.

The Primals, led by the composer and sound director of Final Fantasy XIV Masayoshi Soken, have performed official cover music from Final Fantasy XIV since 2014. They have released multiple albums for the series and have performed in events, including the game's own official Fan Festivals.

The members include (pictured right from left to right) Michael-Christopher Koji Fox (vocalist and game's localizer, translator, and lyricist), Iwai (bassist), Masayoshi Soken (guitarist, vocalist, and game's composer), Tetsuya Tachibana (drummer), and GUNN (guitarist).

Square Enix released Final Fantasy XIV Online for personal computers in September 2010. Square Enix has since released five expansions: "Heavensward" in June 2015, "Stormblood" in June 2017, "Shadowbringers" in July 2019, "Endwalker" in December 2021, and "Dawntrail" in July 2024. The game's "Evercold" expansion will launch on February 19 for early access, and officially on February 23.

title: Classic Shonen Sparks Reboot Rumors After 24 Years
content:
A forgotten anime classic of the 2000s is again in the spotlight after a cryptic post, sparking reboot rumors. Reboot anime series have taken over the industry in recent years, especially with the release of The Ghost in the Shell and Magic Knight Rayearth . With the anime industry growing in massive popularity worldwide, it’s not surprising that it has long become one of the mainstream forms of media. Dozens of anime shows and movies are released each year, introducing unique stories across all kinds of genres. However, despite the newer releases, it can’t be denied that fans still have a soft spot for the 1990s and 2000s shows.

Unfortunately, a majority of the series released during that time never really adapted the entire manga. While some shows maintained a huge fan base over the years, some became known as underrated classics after they couldn’t stand the test of time. GetBackers is one such incredible series that didn’t get the adaptation it deserved. However, with the new rumors circulating around, it might be possible for this 2000s hit series to make its unexpected comeback. The rumors began after @reclaim_00 shared a teaser video hyping the return of a popular Shonen, and all hints point towards GetBackers .

GetBackers Might Be Making a Comeback With a Reboot Anime

The video was initially released in Japanese before the X handle shared an English version. The caption reads, “the strongest duo is back in action” while the video sheds more light on what to expect. It doesn’t drop the name of the series, but it drops enough hints for fans to guess the name. The video mentions that the manga was serialized in Weekly Shonen magazine and has sold over 18 million copies over the years. Not only that, but while the anime debuted in 2002, the manga began serialization in 1999, so it makes sense that the video mentioned the series was famous during the 1990s and 2000s.

The information was shared by a fairly new account that hasn’t posted anything except the announcement video. The first video got over 10 million impressions, causing enough hype before the official reveal. Fans might have to wait at least a few days or weeks to know what to expect from the series. Since the anime never fully adapted the manga, there is a possibility for a sequel instead, but a reboot adaptation after more than two decades would actually make more sense. The original anime doesn’t have catchy visuals, and it requires a modern adaptation to attract new fans.

GetBackers Deserves a Second Chance For Its Unique Story

Written by Shin Kibayashi and illustrated by Rando Ayamine, the story centers on a duo of superhuman operatives, Ginji Amano and Ban Mido, who go by the title of GetBackers . While Amano can generate electric currents with his body like an eel, Mido’s speciality lies in his mysterious Evil Eye, which allows him to create illusions in the minds of his foes. They work as a freelance repossession team based in Shinjuku, Tokyo, as most of their missions revolve around the lost or stolen items of their clients.

The duo has an exceptionally high success rate, and they undertake varying jobs. Thanks to their flawless record, all kinds of clients seek their aid. It goes without saying that the duo wouldn’t turn anyone down because they are broke. Their targets often range from ordinary personal belongings to advanced weaponry, but the story takes a drastic turn when they get into a more dangerous situation than they bargained for. As their troubles continue, the truth behind their complex pasts slowly begins to unravel.

Head down to the comments to tell us if you are excited for the anime to return. Or you could tell us your favorite GetBackers moment.

title: Black Clover Season 2 Episode 7 Preview Continues Fight Against Megicula
content:
Black Clover Season 2 has released preview images and synopsis for Episode 7 (Episode 177 overall) ahead of its November 14 premiere. The new season officially began on October 3, 2026 , with Crunchyroll streaming it worldwide. The anime previously revealed a special Valkyrie Dress Noelle following Episode 6. The official Episode 7 “Beyond Never Giving Up” synopsis:

Noelle and the others are unable to use their magic freely due to the Curse-Warding Magic of the highest-ranking devil, Megicula. Even Gaja’s life-risking suicide attack is blocked, leaving them in a desperate situation with no way out. Just then, Asta and Luck arrive. They prevent the worst from happening and launch a renewed offensive against Megicula. As an intense battle rages between Megicula and the Magic Knights, someone suddenly descends onto the battlefield…

You can see the preview images below:

The main staff for Season 2 includes:

• Director: Ayataka Tanemura

• Series Composition: Keiichiro Ochi

• Character Design: Itsuko Takeda

• Sub-Character Design: Kumiko Tokunaga

• Prop Design: Kosei Takahashi

• Music: Minako Seki

• Animation Production: Studio Pierrot

The opening song by WANIMA is titled “Kienai Riyuu” (The Reason That Won’t Disappear).

ALSO READ: Black Clover Creator Draws Toru Oikawa From Haikyu!! Black Clover Final Volume and Official Guidebook Released, Includes New 15-Page Manga by Yuki Tabata

You can also see the main visual .

The Black Clover manga was serialized in the Weekly Shonen Jump magazine from 2015 to August 2023, before transferring to Jump GIGA . It entered its final arc in August 2022 and officially ended on May 1 after eleven years of serialization. The manga is available to read on Viz Media’s website, MANGA Plus website, and the Shonen Jump mobile app in English.

It received a 170-episode anime adaptation by Studio Pierrot, which ran from 2017 to 2021. The Black Clover: Sword of the Wizard King movie premiered on June 16 and is streaming on Netflix. Crunchyroll streams the TV anime, and they describe the story:

In a world where magic is everything, Asta and Yuno are both found abandoned at a church on the same day. While Yuno is gifted with exceptional magical powers, Asta is the only one in this world without any. At the age of fifteen, both receive grimoires, magic books that amplify their holder’s magic. Asta’s is a rare Grimoire of Anti-Magic that negates and repels his opponent’s spells. Being opposite but good rivals, Yuno and Asta are ready for the hardest of challenges to achieve their common dream: to be the Wizard King. Giving up is never an option!

title: Dragon Ball Super Remake Star Confirms English Dub Will Be Newer Than You Think
content:
Dragon Ball Super is about to kick off the official English dub release for its new remake anime series, and one of the stars behind it all has confirmed that Dragon Ball Super: Beerus is going to be much newer than fans might expect. When Dragon Ball Super: Beerus was first announced to be a newly enhanced version of the original TV anime series , it was touted to feature new animation, new cuts, and more. But unfortunately it’s been revealed that there haven’t been many new lines recorded for the series at this point.

Stars of the original Dragon Ball Super: Beerus Japanese language release revealed that they did not record any new lines for their part of the new series , so fans had been wondering whether or not this would be the same case for the English dub launch. But as Goku voice star Sean Schemmel spoke about during a panel at Collect-A-Con Houston 2026 this past weekend ( as spotted by Anime Secrets on YouTube ), the English voice cast has all returned and are indeed providing new voice work for its release.

Dragon Ball Super: Beerus English Dub Will Feature New Voice Work

“I’ve been working my ass off on it,” Schemmel stated when asked about Dragon Ball Super: Beerus ‘ new English dub release. “I don’t want to go in too much detail because I’m not supposed to…there’s a good amount of original audio being pulled from the edits, but then there’s new stuff which I’m voicing fresh all last week and tomorrow and coming up and so we’re very committed to giving you guys a killer version of Beerus .” As Schemmel further confirmed, the entire cast is committed to this new version , “Crunchyroll’s committed. Toei is committed. The whole cast is here.”

Dragon Ball Super: Beerus ‘ English dub release will begin streaming with Crunchyroll on November 12th at 8:00AM PT, and new episodes will then be releasing on a weekly basis from then on for fans in the United States, Canada, Australia, New Zealand, and Latin America. While the Japanese release has been featuring older audio, and the dub will as well, thankfully it has been confirmed that there will be some brand new materials for fans of the dub to enjoy when it kicks off its own run.

What Does This Mean Dragon Ball Super: Beerus ‘ Future?

If Dragon Ball Super: Beerus will be featuring new English dubbed audio, then there’s a chance that there might be other new materials yet to be seen in the remake anime’s release as well. With the new series confirmed to be tackling the Resurrection F and Universe 6 arcs next, there might be more surprises than expected even if the series is using older audio. The anime has revealed extended versions of fights and other moments seen so far, and at least the dub has confirmed it will offer new materials soon.

Dragon Ball Super: Beerus has reached the climax of the Battle of Gods arc with its latest episode, but it’s yet to be revealed how many episodes it will be running for before it ends. With two more arcs to go, it’s likely we’ll see it air through the Fall and perhaps even through the Winter 2027 anime schedule before it wraps. But are you going to be checking out Dragon Ball Super: Beerus ‘ English dub release? Let us know all of your thoughts about it in the comments.

HT – Anime Secrets
